name: @shaughn-toolkit/design-detector
description: Deterministic, no-LLM static design anti-pattern detector, vendored from Impeccable (Apache-2.0). See README.md and NOTICE.
_optionalDependenciesNote: These four packages enable HTML-aware detection mode (element/page-level rules with real DOM + cascade resolution). Without them, detect.mjs still works in zero-dependency regex mode. Audit before installing (see README.md).
